semiconductor_relevance: High — Crystal Matrix Limited is directly involved in the fabrication of Gallium Nitride (GaN) wafers and MicroLED panels, which are critical components in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Crystal Matrix Limited is pioneering the establishment of India's first Gallium Nitride (GaN) fabrication facility and MicroLED ecosystem. The company focuses on producing GaN epitaxy wafers and Mini/Micro-LED display panels, aiming to support high-end display and lighting applications.

regional_presence.India: Located in the Dholera Special Investment Region, Crystal Matrix Limited is part of the India Semiconductor Mission, focusing on GaN and MicroLED manufacturing.
